description: This PHP class 'MigrationRegistry' manages the registration and checking of migration statuses within a SuiteCRM system, interacting with a database table 'config' to track migration execution status using specific category and migration identifiers.

classes.name: MigrationRegistry
classes.description: Centralized class for managing migration execution status, recording completion, and checking if a migration has been run.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MigrationRegistry, setting up database and logger instances, with error handling if initialization fails.

methods.name: hasMigrationRun
methods.description: Checks if a specific migration identified by migrationId has already been executed by querying the config table.

methods.name: recordMigrationCompletion
methods.description: Records the completion of a migration in the config table with a timestamp, ensuring idempotency with INSERT IGNORE.
